summary: Validated the live FastAPI security baseline and frontend build/smoke behavior. Public status protection, generic invalid-login handling, brute-force throttling, request-size rejection, and security headers passed. No credentials were available, so authenticated session/cookie/CSRF/expiry flows were reviewed statically rather than exercised end-to-end.

critical.issue: TRUSTED_HOSTS is parsed but TrustedHostMiddleware is never installed; Host-header allowlisting is therefore not enforced.

backend/.env sets CORS_ORIGINS="*". Code removes the wildcard, leaving no allowed origins while allow_credentials remains true; browser credentialed frontend requests from an explicit origin will fail CORS instead of being safely allowed.

minor.issue: Request-size enforcement only trusts Content-Length and int() is not guarded; chunked requests can bypass the limit and malformed Content-Length can produce an unintended 500.

issues: The deployed UI is still the starter splash and does not provide the application catalog/authenticated status experience; this matches the known starter-shell context but is not a usable catalog UI.

action_items: Install Starlette TrustedHostMiddleware using the configured TRUSTED_HOSTS.
Replace runtime CORS_ORIGINS wildcard with explicit deployment origins and verify credentialed browser requests.
Harden body-size enforcement for malformed/missing Content-Length and streamed request bodies.
Implement the catalog frontend when product scope moves beyond the starter shell.
critical_code_review_comments: Configuration currently claims trusted-host and explicit-CORS controls that are not effective at runtime; both should fail fast in production rather than silently run with empty CORS origins and no host middleware.
seed_data_creation: None; no credentials or production data were created or modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live unauthenticated status, POST auth rejection, headers, oversized request, generic login failure, and 5-failure throttling passed. Credentials file is intentionally empty; authenticated session cookie flags, CSRF, expiry, admin role, and digest persistence still need an environment with demo credentials or isolated test fixtures. Frontend is the known starter splash.
rca of the issue: Trusted-host RCA: server.py builds trusted_hosts but never adds TrustedHostMiddleware, so the value is dead configuration. CORS RCA: backend/.env uses wildcard while server.py filters wildcard entries; the resulting empty allow_origins list emits no allow-origin for credentialed requests.
